mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review_comments (review_id, user_id, content, created_at) VALUES (#{reviewId}, #{userId}, #{content}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id, c.review_id, c.content, c.created_at, u.user_id, u.nickname, u.profile_image_path as profileImagePath FROM review_comments c JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.review_id = #{reviewId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.created_at ASC
SELECT user_id FROM review_comments WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
